description: This script sets up a testing environment for verifying the preservation of commit subjects during `git format-patch` and `git am` operations. It defines functions to create patches with different subject formats, checks that subjects are preserved after applying patches, and runs a series of tests for short, long, and multiline subjects.

methods.name: make_patches
methods.description: Creates patches with different subject formats (short, long, multiline) for testing.

methods.name: check_subject
methods.description: Checks that the subject of the last commit matches the expected patch subject after applying patches.
